(Currently amended) Claim 1: A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin processed from chicory; and allowing the cement composition to set.

(Currently amended) Claim 9: The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin processed from chicory.
